property_summary: For all inputs the reference C only succeeds (does not revert) when the `_tos` array is non-empty; the mutant inverts that check and thus will accept an empty `_tos` (or revert on non-empty), so there exist fuzzed `_tos` values that make the mutant's success differ from the reference.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 into require(_tos.length == 0) so behavior differs for calls that originally passed the check: now non-empty _tos will revert, and empty _tos will proceed and return true.
